# Fallout 76: Infestation balance adjustment

![Fallout 76: Infestation Balance Adjustment](/uploads/742_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

*German translation:*

Infestation bosses will have their health points reduced slightly today, and we're planning a small reward overhaul for this feature this fall! Here are all the details.

Last week we released our mid-season update, which included some changes to Infestations. We were pleased that many of you responded positively to the more visible server notification and the reduced search area. However, we realize that we set the bosses' health points too high without adjusting the rewards accordingly for the additional time and resources spent.

We want to make the experience more pleasant for everyone and give you a preview of further changes that will come with the fall update.

## From now on

### Reduced health of Infestation bosses

We are reducing the bosses' health points slightly. This is intended to make the fights feel less tough for most players, while still allowing the boss to survive long enough for more people to join in and receive rewards.

## This fall

### Meta goal: “Eliminate enemies”

With the release of the fall update, you will need to find and eliminate enemies in the infested areas to summon the boss. This change complements the health adjustment mentioned above.

### Rewards overhaul

We're planning a small reward update: This will include more ammo drops, guaranteed legendary items from enemies, and a chance for the boss to drop mod boxes.

### Visual effect: Smoke during infestations

We're replacing the green circle on the map with a new smoke effect that more realistically shows the location of an infestation in the game world.

### Comfort improvements (QoL): Visibility settings and free fast travel

If you've had enough of the infestations, a new setting lets you turn off both notifications and visual overlays. In addition, fast travel to team members who are already in an infested area will be free.

Thanks for your feedback on this feature! Community feedback continues to inspire our team, and we look forward to continuing to develop this Appalachian wasteland with you in the years to come.

Source: @Fallout on x.com
